harness.name: ARTEX
harness.description: multi-agent pentest platform; repo closed Oct 2026, forks live on
harness.whatItDid: One controller hit 200+ organizations in 11 days, with access confirmed at nine. Storm-0940 used it to try sign-ins at 2,250+ Microsoft 365 tenants. Zscaler tied a theft of personal data on about 67,000 people from South Korean financial firms to it. Check Point read operator consoles: one operator stole 300+ iOS code-signing certificates. GMO found it on the attack infrastructure behind breaches of Japanese companies. Microsoft names two North Korean actors using it.

uses.quote: ARTEX is an open-source, large language model (LLM)-driven agentic platform that threat actors have weaponized to automate multiple phases of cyber intrusions at machine speed, from reconnaissance through data exfiltration.
Beginning October 17, 2026, CrowdStrike OverWatch observed exploitation activity from a single ARTEX controller directed against entities in at least 14 countries over an 11-day window.

CrowdStrike Intelligence confirmed post-exploitation activity at nine organizations, where the adversary gained access, deployed BLOODALCHEMY, and conducted follow-on credential spraying, network scanning, and reconnaissance.
